sents.text: Why does this matter for AI work?
SSH refuses to use a private key that others can read, so keys must be six hundred.
On a shared GPU server, permissions keep your data and other people's apart.
Scripts need the execute bit before they run.
And with containers and mounted disks, permission denied is one of the first errors you'll meet.
In the lab, you'll create a tiny script, watch it fail with permission denied, fix it with chmod, and practise both the letter form and the number form.
Prompts and hints, never the full answer.
Every file has an owner, a group, and three sets of permissions: read, write and execute, for the owner, the group and everyone else.
ls dash l shows them; chmod changes them, with letters or with numbers like seven five five and six four four; and chown changes the owner.
Next: sudo and root, and how to use that power safely.
